description: Atmosphere in the interior of the Sagrada Familia, or more formally, the Basílica i Temple Expiatori de la Sagrada Família, in Barcelona, Spain. Antonio Gaudi's as-yet unfinished masterwork, begun in 1882, and set to be completed around 2026. It's an awe-inspiring building, with soaring, tree-like pillars and flooded with color from the stained-glass windows. This is a recording, made 2022 June 14, of the hubbub of sound inside the nave with multi-lingual tourists milling about, taking selfies, and gazing upward in awe. (Try playing it back pitched down by and octave or more too!)
name: sagrada_ambience.wav
